entries.reason: The damage pipeline consumes the multi-listener IVehicleDamageModifier socket, which is now answerable from script through eve.provider.publishFor; recording the face makes the provider and any further consumer declare themselves.
entries.thread_affinity: Vehicle simulation owner thread; the damage modifier is called synchronously inside the damage pipeline and retains no script value between hits

trim.absent_profile: Profiles without vehicle drop the module and its IVehicleDamageModifier listeners; the remaining modifiers keep running in registration order

cost_notes: The modifier runs once per damage application and returns an owning modified value; nothing is retained between hit resolutions.
